steps.check: Power indicator is off and fan is silent
steps.failure: Live power can start the fan and injure fingers.
steps.instruction: Press the black power switch to off.

steps.check: Cover is detached and housing is exposed
steps.coach: Pull steady, don't yank the tabs.
steps.failure: Forcing the cover cracks the hinge tabs.

steps.check: Housing is empty with no filter inside
steps.coach: Pull it straight out to keep dust contained.
steps.failure: Leaving the old filter chokes airflow and overheats.
steps.instruction: Pull the old intake filter out of the housing.

steps.check: Housing is clean with no dust buildup or damage
steps.coach: Give it a good look before the new one goes in.
steps.failure: Debris left inside bypasses the new filter.
steps.instruction: Inspect the filter housing for dust and damage.

steps.check: New filter sits flush with gasket sealed all around
steps.coach: Seat it flush, check the gasket.
steps.failure: Poor seating lets unfiltered air into the intake.
steps.instruction: Place the new intake filter into the housing.

steps.check: Cover clicks shut and latch is flush
steps.coach: Close it up and listen for the click.
steps.failure: Loose cover rattles and leaks unfiltered air.
steps.instruction: Place the filter cover back and close it.
